If you’re starting to notice wrinkles, sagging skin, or a loss of firmness around your face, neck, or décolletage, you’re not alone, and you don’t need surgery to take years off your appearance. At AestheticEye in Springboro, OH, we’re proud to offer Sofwave™ skin tightening, an advanced, non-invasive treatment that helps smooth and lift aging skin with impressive results and minimal downtime.

Serving clients across the Dayton and Cincinnati area, AestheticEye brings cutting-edge aesthetic treatments to those who want real results, without the recovery time of invasive procedures.

What Is Sofwave™?

Sofwave™ is a next-generation skin tightening procedure that uses Synchronous Ultrasound Parallel Beam (SUPERB™) technology. This proprietary ultrasound energy is delivered directly to the mid-dermal layer of the skin — the layer responsible for producing collagen and elastin.

Once the skin reaches the optimal temperature, your body’s natural healing response kicks in, stimulating new collagen and elastin production over time. These are the two essential proteins that keep your skin firm, smooth, and youthful, which decrease in the body and skin as you get older.

The result? Visibly tighter skin, reduced wrinkles, and a more refreshed appearance — all without needles, scalpels, or downtime.

Where Can Sofwave™ Help?

Sofwave™ is FDA-cleared to treat mild to moderate wrinkles and skin laxity in the following areas:

  • Face: Smooth forehead lines, smile lines, and sagging cheeks
  • Neck: Lift and tighten loose skin under the chin and jawline
  • Décolletage: Improve texture and firmness in the delicate chest area

Whether you are looking to enhance your appearance for an event or simply want to feel more confident in your own skin, Sofwave™ offers a safe and highly effective solution.

Why Patients Love Sofwave™

In clinical studies, Sofwave™ has shown a 95% patient satisfaction rate for improving fine lines and wrinkles. That’s because it offers powerful results without the side effects, risks, or recovery associated with more aggressive treatments. Key benefits include:

  • Non-invasive: No needles, surgery, or scars
  • Minimal discomfort: Most patients report only a warm sensation during treatment
  • Quick treatments: Sessions typically take 30–45 minutes
  • No downtime: Return to work or social activities the same day
  • Lasting results: Improvements continue to develop over 3–6 months as new collagen forms

At AestheticEye, our expert team will customize your treatment to your skin’s unique needs and goals, ensuring you get the best possible outcome.

Invest in Yourself — the Easy Way

You do not have to wait for loose skin and wrinkles to become more noticeable before taking action. Sofwave™ makes it easy to maintain a youthful appearance and slow the visible signs of aging, all in a safe, comfortable setting.

Ready to turn back the clock? Contact AestheticEye in Springboro, OH, today to schedule your consultation and learn how Sofwave™ skin tightening can help you look younger, refreshed, and confident — just in time for your next big moment.
